description: The FILE file-name-1 alternative of WRITE and REWRITE ({ record-name-1 | FILE file-name-1 } FROM { identifier-1 | literal-1 }, Annex A.4.13 items 1 and 2) - the record released is the FROM operand under the description of the operand (the implicit record of §2023:14.9.51.4 GR8 / §2023:14.9.35.4 GR9; §2002:14.8.47.3 GR5 / §2002:14.8.33.3 GR8). X3.23-1985 prints WRITE record-name-1 and REWRITE record-name-1 only. kb/Work PB5579. Gated in ONE place, VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.VisitWriteStatement / VisitRewriteStatement.
display: the FILE phrase of a WRITE or REWRITE statement
citation: ISO §2023:14.9.51.2 and §2023:14.9.35.2 (FILE file-name-1); the ISO/IEC 1989:2002 formats 14.8.47.1 and 14.8.33.1 print it; §1985:VII.4.7.2 and §1985:VII.4.5.2 print record-name-1 alone
vcr: 2002 introduction (derive from the 2002 standard - Annex E covers 2014->2023 only)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. VMWRF.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT F ASSIGN TO "VMWRF" ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD F.
       01 R PIC X(5).
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 W PIC X(5) VALUE "NEW01".
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           OPEN OUTPUT F.
           WRITE FILE F FROM W.
           CLOSE F.
           STOP RUN.
